purpose: Development candidate discovery using native documentation; no clone truth or refactoring score
implementation: scikit-learn==1.7.2 TfidfVectorizer; dependency versions archived at run
formula: idf(t)=ln((1+N)/(1+df(t)))+1; raw count*idf then L2 normalization; cosine is normalized dot product
fit_scope: All 2180 documents including empty strings; transductive repository indexing, no labels used, not an inductive held-out model
text_policy: Direct literal docs only, unchanged Markdown including examples; no names, ancestors, code bodies, generated summaries or stopword removal added
missing: Keep missing/empty and tokenizer-zero rows in denominators; zero vectors produce no candidates, not a negative truth label
ranking: All unordered distinct pairs with cosine rounded to 12 decimal places >0; descending rounded cosine, ascending lexicographic sorted unit-id pair for ties
budget: Freeze global top20 unique pairs for later development review; archive top100 for diagnostics, no family balancing or reranking after seeing output
comparison: Overlap with all 156 historical SCC outputs is descriptive only: different eligibility and budgets. Report endpoint coverage; not head-to-head accuracy or extra true positives
evaluation: No precision/recall until labels; all proposed pairs unknown. Prior 18 reviewed pairs not held-out. Do not tune this run and claim independent improvement
controls: Independent tiny-corpus count/IDF/cosine calculation, identical and disjoint texts, empty and tokenizer-zero input, negation retained, deterministic ordering
next: Review frozen queue for actual shared functionality, existing delegation, necessary differences and unknowns; design equal-budget baseline comparison separately
